student_visa.name: National visa for studies
key_requirements: APS certificate: applicants with Indian school certificates, semesters or degrees 'almost always' need one (some exemptions)
Blocked account or other accepted proof of funds
Certificate of compulsory health insurance from planned arrival
Proof of fees and payment where a private university charges tuition

proof_of_funds.amount_text: EUR 11,904 for the first year; no more than EUR 992 per month may be withdrawn (DAAD: since 1 January 2025; still shown for 2026). No 2027 figure found.

work_during_study.hours_text: Up to a total of 140 working days per year (Residence Act s.16b(3)); academic student jobs are not counted. DAAD states 140 full or 280 half days.

post_study_work.name: Residence permit to seek qualified employment after graduation
post_study_work.duration_text: Up to 18 months; any job allowed meanwhile; not renewable; apply before the study permit expires.

pr_route.summary: Settlement permit for skilled workers (s.18c(1)): the qualifying period of 3 years falls to 2 years, and pension contributions from 36 to 24 months, for those who studied in Germany; other conditions apply.
pr_route.student_years_count: Half of lawful study time counts for the general settlement permit (s.9(4)) and for EU long-term residence (s.9b(1) no.4).
pr_route.typical_years: 2 years of qualifying work after German studies

health_insurance.text: A certificate of compulsory health insurance covering the period from planned arrival is required.

india_specific.text: APS India verification fee INR 18,000, non-refundable (2026 leaflets). India-Germany Migration and Mobility Partnership Agreement signed 5 December 2022 includes 18-month extended residence permits for students; MEA states it entered into force on 7 March 2023.

countries.climate: General knowledge: temperate, with cold winters and mild to warm summers.
countries.culture_note: General knowledge: German is the official language and English-taught programmes are more common at master's than bachelor's level. Student life centres on university cities, student unions and subsidised canteens.

nri_note.text: No official statement verified on APS or visa handling for Indians resident in the Gulf. The UAE mission publishes its own visa and blocked account pages; apply to the mission responsible for your residence only after confirming there.

notes: Visa fee not verified.
make-it-in-germany blocked direct fetching, so the 18-month figure is from a search summary.
A UAE mission page still showed an older figure (EUR 11,208 / 934).
Whether Indian Class XII qualifies for direct bachelor's entry was not researched.

student_visa.name: Residence permit for study (university / hbo), applied for by the institution
key_requirements: Full-time enrolment at an IND-recognised sponsor in an accredited programme
Sufficient funds
Pass at least 50% of credits each study year
TB test if indicated at application (GGD, within 3 months of receiving the permit)

proof_of_funds.amount_text: EUR 1,130.77 per month for hbo/university, valid 1 January to 31 December 2026; one accepted method is depositing 12 months with the institution. 2027 amount not yet listed.

student_visa.fee: EUR 254.00 (current IND fee page; fees change each 1 January, so 2027 may differ)

work_during_study.hours_text: Employee work needs a work permit (TWV) from the employer: up to 16 hours a week, or full-time in June, July and August. Self-employment needs no TWV.

post_study_work.name: Orientation year residence permit for highly educated persons
post_study_work.duration_text: 1 year; open to those who completed studies in the Netherlands in the past 3 years; no employer work permit needed. Fee EUR 254.

pr_route.summary: EU long-term residence after at least 5 consecutive years of valid Dutch residence, with absence limits and other conditions. Application fee EUR 254.
pr_route.student_years_count: Study-permit time may be counted at 50% for EU long-term residence; not confirmed for the national permanent permit.

health_insurance.text: Those in the country only to study cannot join Dutch public insurance and need sufficient home cover or private/international insurance. A paid job or internship triggers compulsory Dutch public insurance.

india_specific.text: MEA lists an India-Netherlands Migration and Mobility Partnership (7 years, automatic renewal). Signing date and any student clauses not verified.

countries.climate: General knowledge: mild maritime climate, often cloudy, windy and rainy, with cool summers.
countries.culture_note: General knowledge: Dutch is the official language, English is very widely spoken and many degrees are taught in English. Cycling is central to student life and student housing is in short supply.

nri_note.text: The institution applies for the permit. Any entry visa (MVV) is issued through a Dutch mission; the procedure for UAE residents was not verified.

notes: Orientation year, long-term residence and insurance details come from search summaries; some StudyinNL pages are old.

student_visa.name: National D visa for study (stay over 90 days), decided by the cantonal migration office
key_requirements: In-person application at the Swiss Visa Section, New Delhi (India checklist)
Admission letter and proof of fee payment if applicable
Cover letter including confirmation of leaving after studies, CV, academic certificates
English certificate such as TOEFL or IELTS stated as mandatory
Sponsor letter, source of funds, sponsor's ITR-V for 2 assessment years and 3 months of bank statements
student_visa.fee: Free of charge (special cases such as post-doc: EUR 90.00); checklist dated 09.2023

work_during_study.hours_text: Non-EU/EFTA students: only from 6 months after the course starts, maximum 15 hours a week outside holidays; full-time or 40 hours in breaks per official/cantonal sources; university confirmation and notification to authorities required.

post_study_work.name: Short-term residence permit to look for work (Swiss university graduates)
post_study_work.duration_text: 6 months, subject to sufficient funds, accommodation and diploma or written confirmation of completion.

pr_route.summary: Settlement permit C for most non-EU nationals after a regular period of 10 years.
pr_route.student_years_count: Study stays are taken into account only if, after completion, the person has held a long-term residence permit for 2 uninterrupted years (Art. 34(5) AIG; translated from a SEM French directive dated 1 April 2024).

india_specific.text: India-specific student visa checklist (documents above). No student mobility agreement verified; MEA lists a social security agreement.

countries.climate: General knowledge: cold, often snowy winters and warm summers, varying strongly with altitude.
countries.culture_note: General knowledge: German, French, Italian and Romansh are national languages and the teaching language depends on the region. Living costs are high and many bachelor's programmes are taught in a local language.

nri_note.text: The checklist read covers applications in New Delhi; no official statement verified for Indians resident in the UAE.

notes: No fixed proof-of-funds amount found (may be set by canton; not verified).
Health insurance not verified.
Checklist is dated September 2023; its file name mentions a EUR 90 fee although the text says free.

student_visa.name: Student visa
key_requirements: Place with a licensed student sponsor
Funds held 28 days in a row, ending within 31 days of the application
English language ability
Immigration health surcharge
TB test for applicants from India
From outside the UK, apply no earlier than 6 months before the course

proof_of_funds.amount_text: Course fee for one academic year (up to 9 months) plus GBP 1,529 per month (London) or GBP 1,171 per month (outside London) for up to 9 months; gov.uk page read 2026-11-28, no effective date shown.

student_visa.fee: GBP 558 from outside the UK; health surcharge GBP 776 per year extra

work_during_study.hours_text: Full-time degree-level students at a compliant higher education sponsor: 20 hours a week in term time, full-time outside term. Check the visa conditions.

post_study_work.name: Graduate visa
post_study_work.duration_text: 2 years if applied on or before 31 December 2026; 18 months if applied on or after 1 January 2027 (so applies to a 2027 intake); 3 years for doctorates. Fee GBP 937 plus health surcharge usually GBP 1,035 a year; must apply from inside the UK before the Student visa expires.

pr_route.summary: Settlement is normally through work routes. The government's 'earned settlement' policy raises the standard qualifying period from 5 to 10 years, with shorter paths for some higher earners and public service workers. gov.uk also has a 10-year long residence route.
pr_route.student_years_count: Student and Graduate routes do not lead directly to settlement; earned-settlement papers say time on temporary routes will not count. Verify against final Immigration Rules.

health_insurance.text: Immigration Health Surcharge of GBP 776 per year for students, paid with the application, gives access to NHS care.

india_specific.text: India-UK Migration and Mobility Partnership MoU: Young Professionals Scheme, ages 18 to 30, 24 months, up to 3,000 per year. India is on the list of countries requiring a TB test at an approved clinic.

countries.climate: General knowledge: mild, changeable maritime climate with frequent cloud and rain.
countries.culture_note: General knowledge: English is the language of teaching and daily life. Campus societies and sizeable Indian student communities are common.

nri_note.text: Applications can be made from outside the UK. The UAE has approved TB clinics but appears on the separate 'other countries with clinics' page, not the required list; a UAE-resident Indian should check the TB requirement on gov.uk.

notes: Work hours, student surcharge, TB and earned settlement come from search summaries; final earned-settlement rules and transition arrangements were not read.
Older guidance shows GBP 1,483 / 1,136; the live money page shows 1,529 / 1,171.

student_visa.name: Study visa, then immigration registration (Irish Residence Permit, Stamp 2)
key_requirements: Offer on an eligible programme
Proof of funds with 6 months of bank statements
Private medical insurance
Register and pay the IRP fee after arrival

proof_of_funds.amount_text: Courses starting after 1 July 2023: immediate access to at least EUR 10,000, and ready access to at least EUR 10,000 for each subsequent year.

student_visa.fee: Visa EUR 60 single entry / EUR 100 multiple entry; IRP registration EUR 300

work_during_study.hours_text: Stamp 2: 20 hours a week in term time, full time during holidays.

post_study_work.name: Third Level Graduate Programme (Stamp 1G)
post_study_work.duration_text: Level 8 (honours bachelor's): 12 months; level 9 and above: up to 24 months. Official pages are not fully consistent and total student-pathway time is capped.

pr_route.summary: Usually move to an employment permit; naturalisation needs 5 years of reckonable residence in the last 9, including 1 continuous year immediately before applying.
pr_route.student_years_count: Stamp 2/2A student time is not reckonable (narrow young-adult exception). Official stamp guidance is reported to treat Stamp 1G graduate time as reckonable.

health_insurance.text: Evidence of private medical insurance is required.

countries.climate: General knowledge: mild, wet and windy maritime climate with cool summers.
countries.culture_note: General knowledge: English is the everyday and teaching language and Irish is also an official language. Student societies are a large part of campus life.
notes: All figures come from search summaries of official pages.
The funds page sits under a school-level section of irishimmigration.ie; confirm it for degree students.
No India-specific or Gulf-resident rule verified; long-term residency permission not researched; some embassy checklists still show EUR 7,000.

student_visa.name: Long-stay student visa (VLS-TS), after the Etudes en France procedure
key_requirements: Complete Etudes en France (Campus France) first
Admission and proof of funds
Apply at least 3 months before intake
Validate the VLS-TS online within 3 months of arrival

proof_of_funds.amount_text: EUR 877.50 per month from 1 August 2026 (previously EUR 615).

student_visa.fee: Visa EUR 50 for Etudes en France cases, EUR 99 otherwise; Etudes en France fee INR 20,000 from 1 August 2026 (was INR 18,500); validation fee reported as EUR 150

work_during_study.hours_text: Up to 964 hours a year (60% of annual legal working time).

post_study_work.name: Job search / new business creator permit; India-France post-study residence
post_study_work.duration_text: India agreement: for Master's-level graduates, 1 year, extendable by 1 year. Eligibility after only a bachelor's-level degree was not verified.

pr_route.summary: EU long-term resident card for non-EU nationals after at least 5 years of uninterrupted regular residence with sufficient, stable resources.

india_specific.text: India-France Migration and Mobility Partnership (2018) gives the Master's-level 1+1 year stay, with related employment paid at least 1.5 times the minimum wage. A 5-year Schengen short-stay visa (no work) is offered to Indian alumni with at least one semester in France and Master's-level study.

countries.climate: General knowledge: oceanic in the west, more continental in the east and Mediterranean in the south.
countries.culture_note: General knowledge: French is the official language, and English-taught programmes exist, especially at master's level and in business schools. Daily life outside class largely needs French.

nri_note.text: Etudes en France is organised by country of residence; the UAE procedure was not verified.

notes: The EUR 50 rate for Indians is inferred from India using Etudes en France; no page stating it for Indians was read.
Whether student years count toward long-term residence, and student health cover, not verified.

student_visa.name: National D study visa, after Universitaly pre-enrolment
key_requirements: Pre-enrolment / admission
Proof of means with 6 months of bank statements (applicant and any sponsor)
Medical insurance of at least EUR 30,000 incl. repatriation for the first 6 months
Apply for the residence permit within 8 working days of arrival

proof_of_funds.amount_text: Not less than EUR 10,179.85 per year, or EUR 848.32 per month (India checklist, 2026-27 cycle). 2027-28 amount to be confirmed.

work_during_study.hours_text: Up to 20 hours a week, maximum 1,040 hours a year.

post_study_work.name: Residence permit to seek employment after graduation
post_study_work.duration_text: Reported as 9 to 12 months (one official source: 1 year); requires an Italian degree and registration with the employment centre.

health_insurance.text: Private cover of at least EUR 30,000 for the visa; students resident in Italy may voluntarily join the national health service (SSN) for EUR 700 per calendar year.

india_specific.text: India-Italy Agreement on Migration and Mobility signed 2 November 2023 (5 years, automatic renewal), covering students among others. Student clauses not read.

countries.climate: General knowledge: Mediterranean on much of the coast and in the south, with colder winters in the north.
countries.culture_note: General knowledge: Italian is the official language and a growing number of degrees are taught in English. Italian is needed for most part-time jobs and daily administration.
notes: Visa fee and permanent residence route not verified.
A mission page gave 30 November 2026 as the study visa cut-off for 2026-27; expect an annual deadline.
Sponsor eligibility differs between older and 2026-27 checklists.
Figures come from search summaries.

student_visa.name: Study visa
key_requirements: Admission to full-time study at an authorised centre
Proof of funds
Health insurance from an insurer authorised in Spain
Medical certificate for stays over 180 days
Indian police clearance certificate, apostilled and translated
Proof of residence in the consular district

proof_of_funds.amount_text: 100% of IPREM: EUR 600 per month (2026); prepaid accommodation for the full stay can be deducted.

work_during_study.hours_text: Up to 30 hours a week, compatible with studies.

post_study_work.name: Residence authorisation to seek employment or start a business
post_study_work.duration_text: Conflicting official material: ministry information sheet reported as 24 months non-extendable; new-regulation announcement says 1 year. Requires at least a university degree.

pr_route.summary: EU long-term residence after 5 years of residence.
pr_route.student_years_count: Study stays count at 50%, provided the applicant is residing in Spain when applying.

health_insurance.text: Insurance from an insurer authorised in Spain covering all risks covered by the public health system.

india_specific.text: Police Clearance Certificate from the Regional Passport Office, apostilled by India's Ministry of External Affairs, with Spanish translation (Mumbai consulate). No India student mobility agreement verified.

countries.climate: General knowledge: hot, dry summers in much of the interior and south, milder and wetter in the north.
countries.culture_note: General knowledge: Spanish is official nationwide, with co-official regional languages such as Catalan and Basque. Late daily schedules and an active city student life are typical.

nri_note.text: Apply at the consulate for your district; proof of residence there is required (New Delhi page, which also accepts people regularly in the district for study). UAE-specific rules not verified.

notes: Visa fee not verified.
Post-study duration must be confirmed.

student_visa.name: Residence permit for studies
key_requirements: Study place
Funds, plus any unpaid tuition
Valid insurance

proof_of_funds.amount_text: At least EUR 800 per month plus any unpaid tuition; for a permit covering the whole studies, proof is needed for the first year (current Migri information, read 2026-11-28).

student_visa.fee: EUR 600 online / EUR 750 paper for a first study permit, from 1 January 2026

work_during_study.hours_text: Average of 30 hours a week over the year; degree-related practical training or thesis work not counted.

post_study_work.name: Residence permit to look for work
post_study_work.duration_text: Maximum 2 years; apply within 5 years of graduation, including from abroad.

pr_route.summary: From 8 January 2026 the general residence period for permanent residence rose from 4 to 6 years, with language and work-history conditions. Migri states no period of residence is required for applicants relying on a Finnish university bachelor's, master's or higher degree (master's or higher wording also appears generally); check the route's other conditions.

health_insurance.text: Valid insurance is required with the application; type and minimum cover not verified.

india_specific.text: MEA lists an India-Finland Migration and Mobility Partnership dated 5 March 2026 (4-year term); student clauses not verified.

countries.climate: General knowledge: long, cold, dark winters and short, mild summers.
countries.culture_note: General knowledge: Finnish and Swedish are official languages and English is widely spoken. Student unions and subsidised student meals shape campus life.
notes: migri.fi returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch; figures come from search summaries of its pages.
Whether study-permit time counts toward the 6 years was not verified.

student_visa.name: Residence permit for higher education studies
key_requirements: As a general rule apply while outside Sweden; permit issued before travel
Passport; interview or fingerprints may be needed
Maintenance funds
Health insurance if studies last under 1 year

proof_of_funds.amount_text: At least SEK 10,656 per month for applications in 2026 (SEK 10,584 in 2025); reduced if free food or housing is provided. No 2027 figure seen.

work_during_study.hours_text: Bachelor's and master's students: up to 15 hours a week for permits granted on or after 11 June 2026; exceptions include June-August and study-related work.

post_study_work.name: Residence permit to look for work or start a business after studies
post_study_work.duration_text: Up to 1 year for bachelor's or master's graduates (doctoral: 1 year to 18 months). Fee SEK 1,500; maintenance funds required.

pr_route.summary: Work-based permanent residence: work permit (or listed equivalent) and work for 4 of the past 7 years, plus financial and conduct requirements. Rules are being tightened.
pr_route.student_years_count: Student permits were not among the qualifying permits listed in the material seen; not explicitly confirmed.

health_insurance.text: Studies under 1 year: comprehensive insurance required. 1 year or more: register in the population register for access to health and dental care.

india_specific.text: No India student mobility agreement found; MEA lists a social security agreement.

countries.climate: General knowledge: cold winters with short daylight, especially in the north, and mild summers.
countries.culture_note: General knowledge: Swedish is the main language and English is very widely spoken. Student unions and, in some cities, student nations organise much of social life.

nri_note.text: Apply through the e-service or at a Swedish embassy or consulate-general in your country of residence.

notes: Permanent residence summary comes from search results.

student_visa.name: Residence permit for higher education
key_requirements: Admission; self-payers document tuition paid for at least the first semester
Self-support funds in the student's own name; bank statement no older than 30 days
Biometrics within 14 days of an online application

proof_of_funds.amount_text: DKK 7,426 per month (2026 level), documented for up to 12 months: maximum DKK 89,112; an account in a parent's name is not accepted. Further requirements may apply under age 25.

work_during_study.hours_text: State-approved programmes: 90 hours a month September to May, full time June, July and August.

post_study_work.name: Job-seeking residence permit after graduation
post_study_work.duration_text: Applications on or after 1 October 2026: generally 6 months or 1 year for state-approved degrees (PhD generally 3 years); earlier applications could get up to 3 years. Fee DKK 3,060.

pr_route.summary: Permanent residence generally needs 8 years of uninterrupted legal residence; 4 years only if all supplementary requirements are met.
pr_route.student_years_count: Study is listed among permit grounds that may count, but this was not clearly confirmed.

india_specific.text: MEA lists a 2009 India-Denmark Labour Mobility Partnership MoU and a 2024 Agreement on Mobility and Migration Partnership; student clauses not verified.

countries.climate: General knowledge: mild, windy, often grey winters and cool summers.
countries.culture_note: General knowledge: Danish is the official language and English is very widely spoken. Teaching often relies on group projects and open discussion.

nri_note.text: Applications may be submitted to a Danish mission or application centre in the country where you live; check for local extra fees or documents.

notes: Health insurance not verified.
From 1 October 2026 spouses and partners generally cannot come as accompanying family under the student rules.

fx.source: European Central Bank euro foreign exchange reference rates
fx.notes: usd_per_unit is derived as USD per EUR divided by units per EUR. INR is not included; INR fees are quoted as published.
